title: Mars mod!!!
description: this mod adds mars along with bosses and lore. this is my first mod that I will put on modrinth.
body:
mars is cool and other mods let you explore it buut they don't add to much and you want MORE well this is your saving grace

my mod adds the mars dimention with two bosses that spawn in their own structures and multipule enemys like a phantom varient.

the mod also adds two items you can make with the boss drops that are very useful for adventures. this provides fun exploration side plot. if you like dimentions than this is great, and if you just want an extra mod to top things off than this can serve that.

finaly to acsess the entirety of the mod you will need to eat a mars bar. to make this you must use dirt redsand and blue ice, have fun!

this is the first mod i am putting out. i recomend jei for this mod as crafting recipes in this mod are a plenty. thank you shinyboots on minecraftskins.com for the bruno mars skin.

P.S. i will work on this mod in the future
